mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_legacy_matching_index_job ( research_no, cycle_no, include_keyword_text, exclude_keyword_text, applied_years, index_limit, batch_size, require_contact_yn, exclude_blacklist_yn, reset_before_run_yn, status ) VALUES ( #{researchNo}, #{cycleNo}, #{includeKeywordText}, #{excludeKeywordText}, #{appliedYears}, #{indexLimit}, #{batchSize}, #{requireContactYn}, #{excludeBlacklistYn}, #{resetBeforeRunYn}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM admin_legacy_matching_index_job WHERE research_no = #{researchNo} AND COALESCE(include_keyword_text, '') = COALESCE(#{includeKeywordText}, '') AND COALESCE(exclude_keyword_text, '') = COALESCE(#{excludeKeywordText}, '') AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_legacy_matching_index_job SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE admin_legacy_matching_index_job SET status = #{status}, indexed_application_count = #{indexedApplicationCount}, inserted_keyword_count = #{insertedKeywordCount}, skipped_already_indexed_count = #{skippedAlreadyIndexedCount}, reset_before_run_yn = 'N', fail_reason = NULL, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE admin_legacy_matching_index_job SET status = 'FAILED', fail_reason = #{failReason}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE admin_legacy_matching_index_job SET status = 'FAILED', fail_reason = #{failReason}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND requested_at < #{requestedBefore}
UPDATE admin_legacy_matching_index_job SET status = 'FAILED', fail_reason = #{failReason}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
